issues.description: Template uses a string for the classical register size in the Lights Out (Exercise 4) template which will cause an error when constructing ClassicalRegister (it expects an integer). The problem statement asks students to consider the number of classical bits and the solution uses an integer (4). Using a string in the template is an unintended type mistake that will block students from instantiating the circuit and running the template code.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template placeholder for number_of_bits_classical_register from a string to an integer. For example set self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 0 (an int placeholder) or match the solution's value self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 4. Using an int placeholder avoids a type error while preserving the exercise intent for students to fill in the correct number.
